resources.string: After starting, make this phone discoverable and pair from the receiving device’s Bluetooth settings. Refresh this list after pairing. This screen only lists already paired devices. While active, Bluetooth keyboards or mice connected to this phone may be unavailable.
Not connected. Tap Start to prepare the keyboard connection.
Ready. Choose a paired device or connect from the receiver.
Bluetooth keyboard mode requires Android 9 or later and support from this device.
Bluetooth access was not granted. Tap Start to allow access to paired devices.
Permission to make this phone discoverable was not granted. You can still connect an already paired device.
Bluetooth is off. Tap Start to enable it using the system dialog.
The Bluetooth keyboard service is unavailable. Tap Start to try again.
The system could not keep this app registered as a Bluetooth keyboard. Tap Start to try again.
The keyboard connection ended or could not be established. Check the receiver, then tap Start.
The connection stopped accepting keys. Check the receiver, then reconnect.
The connection did not become ready in time. Check Bluetooth on both devices, then tap Start.

resources.string: This device could not open the requested Bluetooth system dialog.
Manual: compose here, then tap Send. Send includes the visible text and any visible preedit text, even if you have not selected a candidate.
Immediate: committed text is sent as you type. Remote autocorrection is not supported. Unsupported text stays here for review; it is not sent automatically again.
Text uses US keyboard key mapping. The receiving device’s keyboard layout and input method determine the resulting characters. Send at most 256 characters at a time.
Compose text for the receiving device
This removes only the text shown here. It does not erase anything already sent to the receiving device.
Connect a device before sending text or control keys.
Send or clear the draft before changing the send mode.
This draft is longer than 256 characters. Split it into smaller parts. No keys were sent.
This text includes characters that cannot be sent with the current key mapping. No keys were sent. Keep the draft and use the receiving device’s input method for those characters.
Keys sent. Check the receiving device for the resulting text.
Some keys may have been sent; draft kept. Review the receiver before retrying.
Sending cancelled; draft kept. Nothing was queued for later.
Apply to the next text send or control key, then clear automatically.
Leaving this screen pauses sending and releases held keys. The app does not keep the connection alive or reconnect automatically; the system may disconnect it in the background.
